name: Qualified medical, dental or TCM reimbursement
authority: CPF Act 1953 s.2(1), CPF (Wages — Excluded Payments) Notification 2019 paras.2–3 https://sso.agc.gov.sg/SL/CPFA1953-N12?DocDate=20251217 ; Skills Development Levy Act 1979 s.2, SDL (Wages — Excluded Payments) Notification 2023 paras.2–3 https://sso.agc.gov.sg/SL/SDLA1979-S375-2023?DocDate=20230614
qualifies_when: entry.due_on >= "2023-06-15" && entry.incurred_on != "" && entry.incurred_on <= entry.due_on && entry.facts.amount_incurred >= entry.amount && entry.facts.patient in ["EMPLOYEE", "SPOUSE", "NATURAL_CHILD", "STEPCHILD", "ADOPTED_CHILD", "GUARDIANSHIP_CHILD", "FOSTER_CHILD"] && (entry.facts.patient == "EMPLOYEE" || (entry.facts.relationship_recognised && entry.facts.relationship_from != "" && entry.facts.relationship_from <= entry.due_on && (entry.facts.relationship_through == "" || entry.due_on <= entry.facts.relationship_through))) && entry.facts.practitioner_qualified && ((entry.facts.treatment == "DENTAL_HYGIENE" && !entry.facts.solely_aesthetic) || (entry.facts.treatment in ["MEDICAL", "DENTAL", "TCM"] && entry.facts.treatment_necessary && !entry.facts.solely_aesthetic))

name: Medical consultation fee for certified sick leave
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.89(7A) (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968?ProvIds=pr89-), read 2026-10-07: after 3 months’ service the employer bears or reimburses the fee of the examination when the practitioner is appointed by the employer or is a medical officer and the employee is certified to paid sick leave; s.89(8): a Commissioner-approved healthcare scheme discharges it; s.89(10): not for cosmetic treatment. A medical reimbursement, outside CPF and SDL wages (CPF (Wages — Excluded Payments) Notification 2019). Customer input: entry.facts.practitioner (EMPLOYER_APPOINTED | MEDICAL_OFFICER | OTHER), paid_sick_leave_certified, cosmetic.
qualifies_when: employment.service_months >= 3 && has(entry.facts.practitioner) && entry.facts.practitioner in ["EMPLOYER_APPOINTED", "MEDICAL_OFFICER"] && has(entry.facts.paid_sick_leave_certified) && entry.facts.paid_sick_leave_certified == true && !(has(entry.facts.cosmetic) && entry.facts.cosmetic == true)

name: Per diem reimbursement of actual official expenses
authority: CPF Board, per-diem payments: official-purpose expense reimbursements do not attract CPF only when the employer can prove the purpose and the reimbursement does not exceed actual expenditure. A lump-sum allowance remains wages. https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/article/are-cpf-contributions-payable-on-per-diem-payments (retrieved 2026-10-03).
qualifies_when: entry.incurred_on != "" && entry.incurred_on <= entry.due_on && entry.facts.official_purpose && entry.facts.actual_expenditure >= entry.amount && entry.facts.purpose_reference != ""

name: Government-paid adoption leave reimbursement
authority: Current CDCA s9(1),(1A),(1B),12AA,12DA; CDCR7 thirteen D branches. Requires the original lawful source admission and exact statutory origin derivation. MSF ProFamily Leave (read 2026-10-07): $2,500 a week including CPF; a day-based claim is capped at $2,500 ÷ the working days a week, so entry.quantity is the weeks claimed = days ÷ working days a week. Per-child-order totals (MSF, read 2026-10-07): GPML $20,000 (1st/2nd) or $40,000 (3rd+), GPPL $10,000, GPAL $20,000 or $30,000 — the claim adds to the same child’s earlier claims (entry.facts.child_id, child_order). Employer-paid portion (MSF): GPAL weeks 1–4 of a 1st or 2nd child are employer-paid; customer input: entry.facts.claim_from_week (the first week the claim covers).
qualifies_when: entry.facts.service_months >= 3 && entry.facts["cdca_original_statutory_origin"] != "" && entry.amount <= 2500.0 * entry.quantity && entry.amount + sum(earlier.rows.filter(r, has(r.child_id) && has(entry.child_id) && r.child_id == entry.child_id).map(r, r.amount)) <= (has(entry.child_order) && entry.child_order >= 3 ? 30000.0 : 20000.0) && (!has(entry.claim_from_week) || (has(entry.child_order) && entry.child_order >= 3) || entry.claim_from_week >= 5)

name: Government-paid paternity leave reimbursement
authority: Child Development Co-Savings Act2001 ss12H,12I,12J; Child Development Co-Savings(Leave and Benefits)Regulations2017 reg8. Qualified original statutory paternity arrangements only; actual individually paid leave wages/employer CPF, original weekly index, actual allowance history and source-funded workdays. Four-week April2025 Scheme origins; two-week other/stillbirth origins. Government refund and employer cost are separately source-linked; no refund is an employee grant. https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/CDCSA2001?ProvIds=P13-; https://sso.agc.gov.sg/SL/CDCSA2001-S358-2017?ProvIds=pr8- MSF ProFamily Leave (read 2026-10-07): $2,500 a week including CPF; a day-based claim is capped at $2,500 ÷ the working days a week, so entry.quantity is the weeks claimed = days ÷ working days a week. Per-child-order totals (MSF, read 2026-10-07): GPML $20,000 (1st/2nd) or $40,000 (3rd+), GPPL $10,000, GPAL $20,000 or $30,000 — the claim adds to the same child’s earlier claims (entry.facts.child_id, child_order).
qualifies_when: entry.facts.service_months >= 3 && entry.facts["cdca_original_statutory_origin"] != "" && entry.amount <= 2500.0 * entry.quantity && entry.amount + sum(earlier.rows.filter(r, has(r.child_id) && has(entry.child_id) && r.child_id == entry.child_id).map(r, r.amount)) <= 10000.0

name: WICA medical insurer recovery
authority: Work Injury Compensation Act 2019 ss.2, 3, 7–12, 17 and First Schedule paras.4 and 6; MOM WICA types of compensation and medical-leave-wages calculator.

name: Government-paid shared parental leave reimbursement
authority: Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 ss.12DA–12DD; MSF ProFamily Leave, Shared parental leave (https://www.profamilyleave.msf.gov.sg/schemes/shared-parental-leave), read 2026-10-07: reimbursed at up to $2,500 a week including CPF, claimed no later than 3 months after the last day of the leave; entry.quantity is the weeks claimed (days ÷ working days a week).

name: Government-paid childcare leave reimbursement
authority: Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 s.12B; MSF ProFamily Leave, Childcare leave (https://www.profamilyleave.msf.gov.sg/schemes/childcare-leave), read 2026-10-07: GPCL days 4–6 and both extended childcare days are reimbursed at up to $500 a day including CPF ($1,500 / $1,000 a year), claimed no later than 3 months after the calendar year; entry.quantity is the days claimed. Employer-paid portion (MSF): GPCL days 1–3 of the year are employer-paid (ECL days are all reimbursed); customer input: entry.facts.claim_from_day (the first day the claim covers). Yearly totals per child (MSF): $1,500 of GPCL (days 4–6) or $1,000 of ECL (a child of 7 or over, entry.facts.child_birthdate) across the same child’s claims of the calendar year.
qualifies_when: entry.facts.service_months >= 3 && entry.amount <= 500.0 * entry.quantity && (!has(entry.claim_from_day) || (has(entry.child_birthdate) && age_on(entry.child_birthdate, entry.occurred_on) >= 7) || entry.claim_from_day >= 4) && entry.amount + sum(earlier.rows.filter(r, has(r.child_id) && has(entry.child_id) && r.child_id == entry.child_id && string(r.occurred_on).substring(0, 4) == string(entry.occurred_on).substring(0, 4)).map(r, r.amount)) <= (has(entry.child_birthdate) && age_on(entry.child_birthdate, entry.occurred_on) >= 7 ? 1000.0 : 1500.0)
